motivation: A native Kew SID source contributes observations to 78.88% of original seed mass species-system cells and 51.16% cannot be retained after excluding its source ID; test whether using Kew changes K, independent from source-driven tip pruning.

graph.other_traits: Never recompute or choose based on original K result or alter their original graph

paired_tip_design.species: Rebuild the original source-native all-dataset median and Kew-removed median for EXACTLY the same pre-outcome Kew-removed-positive species; do not add formerly excluded original-K species.
paired_tip_design.tree_membership: Compute each paired K on an identical generated tree and identical tip set. The only contrast within each paired tree is the trait state sourced from all datasets versus non-Kew datasets.
paired_tip_design.axis_support: If either generated S3/prune-only tree has fewer than 20 matched tips, mark that axis HOLD rather than adapting the threshold. Do not pick families based on K effect.
paired_tip_design.K_estimand: Blomberg K of natural log of positive species median trait values, using phytools::phylosig(method=K,test=FALSE) to reproduce original K implementation.
comparison: delta_total_logK = delta_source_logK + delta_support_geometry_logK, exploratory source+tip geometry decomposition

final_summary.stratification: 13 presupported family systems; separate S3 and prune, descriptive median delta_source, range and signs; no p-values or selection claims
